newsitem.title: USA: Community Care officers' services ended.
newsitem.headline: Community Care officers' services ended.

text.p: Community Care Services Inc said Wednesday that it has terminated the services of Alan Sheinwald, president and chief executive, and Allan Goldfeder, chief operating officer.
The company said the decision follows an earlier announcement that the two men and the company itself are targets of a federal criminal investigation.
Community Care said it has pledged its complete cooperation and the cooperation of all its employees in the federal probe.
Dean Sloane and Bruce Ansnes, directors, will supervise management operations on an interim basis pending further action by the board, said the company.
Community Care is a provider of home healthcare products and services in the New York metropolitan area.
